question: Does the current 10-point rubric materially double-count the same reactive market-state information through Funding confirmation and completed-month market confirmation?

inputs.funding: Promoted Funding V2 effective_score, aligned by its frozen available month.
inputs.market_confirmation: Exact current engine rule reconstructed monthly for SPY/QQQ/GLD/DBC: price > 10M MA OR 3M return > 0; score 2 if >=3/4 positive, 1 if 2/4, else 0.

fixed_tests: Pearson and Spearman association between Funding raw score and market-confirmation 0-2 score.
Pearson and Spearman association between Funding rubric 0-2 score and market-confirmation 0-2 score.
Exact-score agreement rate and contingency table.
Forward SPY 12M HAC regression: market confirmation only versus market confirmation + Funding raw score; Funding coefficient and incremental R-squared are descriptive only.
sample: All aligned months from promoted Funding V2 history with four-asset market confirmation and fully observed SPY 12M forward return.
guardrail: No rubric change may be made from this diagnostic. A material weighting/de-duplication change requires a separately frozen decision-engine candidate.
